mu_name_from: MuMain loads MODEL_ECLIPSE_* from Data/Player/CW_GloveMale02.bmd (ZzzOpenData.cpp:236-245; the helm is CW_HelmMale 2). MU's number 35. Ours is *Male36 by the index-plus-one rule.
why_this_one: Season 2's lower-level sets, missing here (the user, 2026-10-22: 'we need those low level items now', every class's but the Dark Lord's): the Dark Wizard's.

stats.note: The item's own row: OpenMU's Season 6 initialiser (Season 2's sets; 0.75 and 0.95d have none).
stats.class_level_note: The Dark Wizard's, first class and up: OpenMU's darkWizardClassLevel 1. OpenMU gives the Magic Gladiator none of it.

sheet_from: MuMain/src/bin/Data/Player rich*.OZJ and richfama.OZT, decoded with pipeline/decode_texture.py: dark plate traced in silver over a dark robe; richface his face, richfama the hair card cut by its own alpha, richcrystal a teal gem.
material_note: painted_steel with the cast grain for the plate; the robe (richlower) cloth, as Dark Soul's; the face skin; the hair card hair.
material_overrides_note: painted_steel's own grain is a blade's, brushed along V; on plate it drew vertical streaks (studio, 2026-10-04). plate_steel's cast grain instead, the paint left as it is.
effects_note: MuMain has no render arm for MODEL_ECLIPSE_* (no glow, no chrome pass).
